KB-003 (temperature drift) explicitly distinguishes two cases: if the controller reading tracks the cabin probe, the refrigeration circuit itself is at fault and needs a technician; only if the controller reading diverges from the cabin probe (sensor calibration drift) does the diagnostic reset apply. Since the readings track each other here, plus the overcurrent spike immediately preceding a hard compressor fault/shutdown, this points to an actual compressor/circuit hardware failure rather than a sensor or calibration issue. No service history exists for this unit, and no KB entry directly documents an overcurrent-trip fix, so a technician visit is the appropriate and more cautious action.
